Name: Moon Misadventures Redux
Author: deleted285543707
Description:
[size=4][color=#ffff00][size=3]*[/size][/color][size=3][color=#ffffff]If you[/color] [color=#00ff00]like[/color] [color=#ffffff]my[/color] [color=#00ffff]mods[/color] [color=#ffffff]consider[/color] [color=#ff0000]Endorsing[/color]![color=#ffff00]*[/color][/size][/size]


[b][size=4]Taken from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10612]Original[/url] mod description.[/size][/b]

"Visit the dwarf and repair an ancient vehicle of his with late-game materials, and visit the moon for a new challenge.

This mod includes:
[list]
[*][s]Two[/s] One new tool tier, [s]radioactive and[/s] mythicite.[/*]
[*]A new procedural 'dungeon' located on the moon, with new ore, new enemies, and new treasure.[/*]
[*]New ore: Mythicite[/*]
[*]New enemies: Currently slimes, and a mob that shoots explosions.[/*]
[*]New treasures: New structures that can contain necklaces, anti-gravity gauntlets (moves moon animals around), new boots, and materials for the Celestial Infuser.[/*]
[*]A new area to farm in, with certain things (animals and crops) that only function on the moon. (These must be found in the dungeon.)[/*]
[*]A new accessory type and slot for it, obtainable only on the moon.[/*]
[*]The Celestial Infuser, a new 'forge', usable for a new tier of weapons, getting a second enchantment on tools, and making an item guaranteed not lost on death."[/*]
[/list][b]The Original mod did not have a finished boss battle so I imported the one from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26055]Terraria Bosses[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/GlitchedDeveloper]GlitchedDeveloper[/url].[/b]

[b]The original mod had UFO interiors and looked like it was going to add some artifacts. I have reopened the interior and changed the dialogue when interacting with the UFO to reflect that. I used modified textures from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13086]Animated Orbs[/url] to add some artifacts. You get these by defeating the dungeon boss. You will have to do it six times for all six orbs. Any rewards after that from defeating the boss will either be a Prismatic Shard or a Galaxy Soul making it a lucrative farming opportunity.[/b]

[b]I will be reintroducing the weapons hidden in the mod in a future update. I also plan to fix the animal system and introduce buildings and more moon animals.  [/b]

I have adjusted a few things.[b] [/b]I have removed the Radioactive tool upgrades because [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47246]Tool and Sprinkler Upgrades[/url] already has them. The tools added by this remain level 6 upgrades. This means they are also able to feed into the level 7 tools in TSU and they also can be upgraded into from both Cobalt and the Stygium tools if you have Sword and Sorcery installed as well. Your weapon now takes over the old pickaxe usage for creating rock bridges and now silently reads your currently held tool level. Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47136]Wallet Tools[/url].

I have changed the necklace slot so the old patch needed for use with bigger backpack is not needed anymore. I also recolored it and it is now universally compatible with any recolor or UI mod.

All of my mods and their source code are on [url=https://github.com/ThaleTheGreat/ThalesStardewValleyMods]GitHub[/url][/b]
